title: The reduced form at every order: the Jordan chains of the cut-open torus at powers of two
claim: Pre-registered 2026-11-10, before the proof attempt. At n = 2^m, h = n/2, q = 2n, for a in GF(q)* with b = sqrt(a), Z(w) = S + M_(Omega(w)) the family of JORDAN-CHAINS-20261110-001A (Z(a) = X_b), G the monic least-degree element of ker X_b, k = h - deg G, J = ceil(k/2), u = (w - a)/a and L(x) = x + x^2 + x^4 + ...: to be proved (1) the sparse Taylor form Omega(a + d) = (1 + d/a)(Omega_a + sum over r = 1..m-1 of d^(2^r) k^(h - 2^(r-1))) mod d^n, the perturbation being k^h L(d^2/k); (2) the Hankel reduction: near a, Z(w) is equivalent to diag(H(w), I), H(w) the (h/2) x (h/2) Hankel matrix of psi_1(w), ..., psi_(h-1)(w), psi(w) = (Omega(w) + k + 1)/(k Omega(w) + (k + 1)^2) mod k^h written in Y = k^2 + k; (3) Gamma^(k) = [k - i - j is a power of two]_(0 <= i, j < J) is invertible over GF(2) for every k. Target, the leading form, found by exact computation at every a for sides 8 to 64 before registration: the symmetric Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction M of Z to ker X_b = G F[Y]_(<J) (basis G Y^j, complement spanned by the monomials k^d off the kernel's top degrees deg G + 2j) has M_ij = u^(2k - 1 - 2(i + j)) (Gamma^(k)_ij + O(u)), its leading part being u^-1 Y^k L(u^2/Y); with (3) G Y^j then heads a Jordan chain of exactly 2k - 1 - 4j and these are the Jordan blocks at 1/a. The valuations alone give the multiplicity at least k(k + 1)/2, which with the degree bound deg G <= h - k_a (sub-goal B74) would prove the collapse.
failure_conditions: A side 2^m and a in GF(2n)* at which the sparse Taylor form fails, or the partial multiplicities of H(w) at a differ from those of Z(w).
A k at which Gamma^(k) is singular over GF(2) (computed false for k < 400).

A side, a and (i, j) at which M_ij has a nonzero coefficient below u^(2k - 1 - 2(i + j)), or its coefficient there differs from Gamma^(k)_ij (computed false at every a for sides 8 to 64; side 128 is a planned check after registration).
remaining_obligations: the leading form, or the order where the argument stops
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2), at sides 2^m. The spectrum is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared (A45).

validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the coordinator's go-ahead on 2026-11-10 (sub-goal B73 continued).
validation.status: pre-registered; the leading form found by exact computation, the proofs to follow
